name: effort bump for an agent already on the model a decision's prose calls advisor-only
why: Owner, 2026-11-21: the reviewer reads model choices from the compiled settings, not from decision prose that goes stale. MODEL_SETTINGS shows the maintainer already runs GPT Sol; the decisions digest still says GPT Sol is the advisor only. The owner asked to raise the maintainer's effort; the model it already uses is not a reason to reject.

card.sentence: Merge 1 PR: raise the maintainer's reasoning effort

diff:
### https://github.com/acme-agents/aidenhq-instance/pull/88 base main
diff --git a/instance.yaml b/instance.yaml
index 3a4b5c6..7d8e9f0 100644
--- a/instance.yaml
+++ b/instance.yaml
@@ -31,7 +31,7 @@ overrides:
   agents:
     maintainer:
       model: ~openai/gpt-sol-latest
-      reasoning_effort: medium
+      reasoning_effort: high
       caps:
         day_usd: 30

decisions.text:
# Product decisions

## Not building

- Kimi, Claude and Gemini models in normal operation: agents run DeepSeek Flash, checkers GPT Luna, GPT Sol is the advisor only. (2026-11-13, owner)

## Decided

- The product pin only moves forward along product main. (2026-11-10, O-17)

settings:
chief-of-staff: engine codex, model ~deepseek/deepseek-flash-latest, effort high
maintainer: engine codex, model ~openai/gpt-sol-latest, effort medium

chain: Owner: the maintainer misses edge cases in its triage. Raise its reasoning effort from medium to high in instance.yaml; keep its model.
claim: Raises the maintainer's reasoning effort to high.
